visual.name: bfusionFinancialOverview
visual.description: Combo chart (grouped bars + lines) with data table and insights sidebar for project financial management. Measures: Budget, Actuals, Forecast, Initial Budget, Committed Spend. Supports currency formatting and timeline drill-down.

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Time axis — supports Year > Quarter > Month > Week drill hierarchy.

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: Total budget amount (e.g. Total Budget, Budget Cost). Required.

dataRoles.name: actuals
dataRoles.description: Actual cost / spend (e.g. Actual Cost). Required.

dataRoles.name: forecast
dataRoles.description: Forecast cost (optional). Shown as dashed line.

dataRoles.name: initialBudget
dataRoles.description: Original / initial budget baseline (optional). Shown as reference line.

dataRoles.name: committed
dataRoles.description: Committed spend / encumbered cost (optional). Shown as additional bar.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

chartHeightRatio.description: Portion of visual height used by the chart (0.2 – 0.9).

valueScale.description: Divide values by this factor for display (1 = raw, 1000 = K, 1000000 = M).

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
